Vhessk.personality: The Wave Shaper, Tide Sovereign of the Szeth'Rathul. Hunched and twisted even by wave shaper standards.
Vhessk.spec_traits:
Legendary Resistance (3/Day). If he fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.
Blood Frenzy. Advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hit points.
Limited Amphibiousness. Breathes air and water, but must submerge at least once every 4 hours.
Shark Telepathy. He can magically command any shark within 120 feet.
Tidal Ward. Water coils around him. The ground within 15 feet is difficult terrain for his enemies, and he has advantage on saves against being moved or knocked prone.
Vhessk.features: AC 16 (coral carapace). HP 142 (19d8 + 57). Challenge 6 (2,300 XP), proficiency +3.
Vhessk.actions:
Multiattack. Two Trident attacks and one Water Jet.
Trident. Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing plus 3 (1d6) cold.
Water Jet. Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, range 90 ft. Hit: 10 (3d6) cold, and a DC 15 Strength save or pushed 10 feet.
Whirlpool (1/Day). Concentration, up to 10 minutes. He closes a fist and the water obeys. The water must be at least 50 feet square and 25 feet deep; a whirlpool forms at the centre of it, 5 feet wide at the base, up to 50 feet wide at the top, and 25 feet tall, lasting until he chooses a different effect or the spell ends.
  Any creature in the water and within 25 feet of the whirlpool is pulled 10 feet toward it. When a creature enters the whirlpool for the first time on a turn, or ends its turn there, it makes a DC 15 Strength saving throw, taking 9 (2d8) bludgeoning damage on a failure or half as much on a success. A creature can swim away from the whirlpool only if it first takes an action to pull away and succeeds on a DC 15 Strength (Athletics) check.
Vhessk.leg_actions:
Three per round, one at a time, at the end of another creature's turn.
Surge. He swims up to his speed without provoking opportunity attacks.
Water Jet (Costs 1). One Water Jet attack.
Undertow (Costs 2). One creature within 30 ft. makes a DC 15 Strength save or is pulled 20 feet toward him and knocked prone.
Call the Deep (Costs 3). Each enemy within 20 ft. makes a DC 15 Constitution save or takes 10 (3d6) cold and has its speed halved until the end of its next turn.
Vhessk.special_abilities:
THE DROWNED PACT — when he drops to 0 hit points, once only.
He dies, and then he stands up. He gains 20 temporary hit points that cannot be healed, restored or replenished by any means. When those are gone, he is gone. On standing, he immediately uses The Drowned Answer; after that he acts normally, legendary actions and all.

THE DROWNED ANSWER. He does not cast it. He opens his mouth and lets something else use it. The voice is not his.
Everything that ever drowned in this lake surfaces at once — triton, sahuagin, fish, children. 60-foot radius centred on him. DC 15 Constitution, 21 (6d6) necrotic, half on a success. The water goes black and stays black.
The other sahuagin are not immune, and they will be horrified. This is not Sekolah's magic and every one of them knows it on sight.

Ssharai.personality: Priestess of Sekolah. Believes every word she speaks for him — which is exactly what makes her arguable with.
Ssharai.spec_traits:
Blood Frenzy. Advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hit points.
Limited Amphibiousness. She can breathe air and water, but needs to be submerged at least once every 4 hours to avoid suffocating.
Shark Telepathy. She can magically command any shark within 120 feet of her, using a limited telepathy.
Ssharai.features:
Spellcasting. A 6th-level spellcaster; Wisdom, save DC 12, +4 to hit. Slots 4 / 3 / 3.
AC 12 (natural armour). HP 33 (6d8 + 6). Challenge 2 (450 XP), proficiency +2.
Ssharai.actions:
Multiattack. Two melee attacks: one with her Bite and one with her Claws.
Bite. Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing.
Claws. Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) slashing.
Control Water (1/Day). Concentration, up to 10 minutes. She takes hold of water she can see within 300 feet, in a cube up to 100 feet on a side, and chooses one of four effects. She can change the effect on a later turn.
  Flood. Raise the water level by up to 20 feet, or — in a body at least 50 feet wide — send a 20-foot wave crashing in a direction she chooses: DC 12 Strength or be knocked prone and carried with it.
  Part Water. Open a trench through the area, its sides walls of water.
  Redirect Flow. Make flowing water run in a direction she chooses, even over obstacles, up walls and in other unlikely directions.
  Whirlpool. Exactly as Vhessk's, using her DC 12.

Nerida Stormtide.personality: Oracle of Nathoud — the oracle who warned Nathoud's king that something was coming. Ally.
Nerida Stormtide.spec_traits:
Already Seen It (3/Day). She can't be surprised. When a creature she can see attacks her or an ally within 30 feet, she imposes disadvantage on that roll — she called the warning half a second early.
Foreseen, Not Fearless. Advantage on saves against being charmed or frightened. Not immunity: she has seen worse than you coming, but she is not unshakeable.
The Tide Remembers (1/Day). She asks the waters about one event that happened within Nathoud in the past 500 years. Images and feeling, never words.
Nerida Stormtide.features:
Spellcasting. Wisdom, save DC 15, +7 to hit; 7th-level caster, slots 4 / 3 / 3 / 1.
Treat as Challenge 4.

spell_names.0: Guidance, Mending, Ray of Frost, Thaumaturgy
spell_names.1: Bane, Create or Destroy Water, Detect Magic, Healing Word

Nerida Stormtide.actions:
Tidelash. Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, range 60 ft. Hit: 9 (2d8) cold.
Turn of the Tide (1/Day). Her eyes go white and for one heartbeat everyone near her sees a few seconds that have not happened yet. Each ally within 30 feet gains one foresight die: once in the next minute, after making a d20 roll — attack, check or save — but before learning whether it succeeded, they may reroll it and must use the new result. One reroll each; any still unspent fade when the minute ends.

Pilika Greenbottle.personality: Met at the petrified village and again in the Great Wild Wood, where she and Seryla were heading to Laputa to research the ice. Asked to come to Nathoud. Ally.
Pilika Greenbottle.spec_traits:
Jack of All Trades. +1 to any ability check she is not already proficient in.
Lucky. Reroll a natural 1 on an attack, check or save.
Brave. Advantage against being frightened.
Halfling Nimbleness. Can move through the space of any creature larger than her.
Song of Rest (d8). Allies who spend a short rest with her regain an extra d8 when they spend Hit Dice.
Pilika Greenbottle.features:
Spellcasting. Charisma, save DC 15, +7 to hit; slots 4 / 3 / 3 / 1. Ten prepared bard spells, plus two from Magical Discoveries (Beacon of Hope, Counterspell) — the College of Lore feature at 6th level, which takes two spells from the Cleric, Druid or Wizard lists. (Magical Secrets is the separate 10th-level feature; she does not have it.)
Countercharm. Action. Until the end of her next turn, she and allies within 30 feet have advantage on saves against being frightened or charmed, for as long as she keeps performing.

spell_names.1: Healing Word, Faerie Fire, Dissonant Whispers, Heroism
spell_names.3: Hypnotic Pattern, Mass Healing Word, Counterspell

Pilika Greenbottle.equipment: Normally studded leather (AC 15), an instrument and a component pouch. In the Oracle's Chamber she has lost everything she carried.
Pilika Greenbottle.actions:
Vicious Mockery (Cantrip). One creature within 60 ft. that can hear her. DC 15 Wisdom save or 5 (2d4) psychic and disadvantage on its next attack roll before the end of its next turn.
Unarmed Strike. +2 to hit, 1 bludgeoning. She has no weapon.
Pilika Greenbottle.bonus_actions:
Bardic Inspiration (d8, 4/Short Rest). Bonus action. One creature other than herself within 60 feet who can hear her gains a d8 for 10 minutes, added to one attack roll, ability check or saving throw of its choice.
Cutting Words. Reaction, expending one Bardic Inspiration. When a creature within 60 feet that she can see makes an attack roll, ability check or damage roll, she subtracts a d8 from it — declared after the roll, before the outcome.
